svg.title: Challenge 2 · Where the fluid can move
svg.desc: Two channel diagrams show one and three rectangular chips excluded from the sampled fluid; inlet and outlet remain separate from no-slip walls. Level 3 uses the same single chip and adds time.

g.text: Challenge 2 · Where the fluid can move
The fluid domain is the channel minus the solid chip rectangles.
Level 1 is steady; Level 3 also samples t in [0, 10].
The surrounding channel stays x in [−2.5, 2.5], y in [−0.5, 0.5].
Where the shape becomes sampled points
sample_walls selects exposed segments; sample_flux integrates only the fluid height.
Domain schematic only. Dots illustrate sampling, not a computed velocity field.
